title: Billing and invoices
text:
Acme Workspace bills monthly on the date your subscription started.
Invoices are emailed to the account owner and can be downloaded as PDF from Settings > Billing.
To change the billing email, an owner opens Settings > Billing and edits the invoice contact.
Refunds for annual plans are prorated if requested within 30 days of renewal.
Need help? Contact support from the in-app chat.
This article is part of the synthetic Acme Workspace help centre.

title: Single sign-on (SSO)
text:
SSO with SAML 2.0 is available on the Business and Enterprise plans.
An administrator uploads the identity provider metadata XML under Settings > Security > SSO.
After SSO is enforced, password login is disabled for all members except one break-glass owner account.
SCIM provisioning creates and deactivates users automatically when they change in the identity provider.
Need help? Contact support from the in-app chat.
This article is part of the synthetic Acme Workspace help centre.

title: Exporting your data
text:
Owners can export all workspace data as a ZIP archive containing JSON and CSV files.
Exports are generated in the background and a download link is emailed when ready.
Download links expire after 7 days for security reasons.
Large workspaces above 10 GB are split into several archives.
Need help? Contact support from the in-app chat.
This article is part of the synthetic Acme Workspace help centre.

title: Data retention and deletion
text:
Deleted pages stay in the trash for 30 days and can be restored by any editor.
After 30 days, trashed content is permanently removed from primary storage.
Backups containing deleted content are purged within a further 35 days.
Enterprise plans can set a custom retention period between 1 and 10 years.
Need help? Contact support from the in-app chat.
This article is part of the synthetic Acme Workspace help centre.

title: API rate limits
text:
The public REST API allows 300 requests per minute per access token.
Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.
Bulk endpoints accept up to 100 records per call and count as a single request.
Webhooks are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.
Need help? Contact support from the in-app chat.

title: Roles and permissions
text:
Workspaces have four roles: owner, admin, editor and viewer.
Only owners can delete the workspace or change the subscription plan.
Admins manage members and security settings but cannot see billing.
Guests can be invited to a single page with view or comment access.
